cohort: Women at 37-42 weeks of gestation with meconium stained amniotic fluid during labor and delivery at MGMC&RI, Puducherry.
finding: Meconium stained amniotic fluid (MSAF) had a prevalence of 12.42% and was associated with a high rate of cesarean section (84.28%), NICU admissions (20%), and neonatal deaths (7.14% of NICU admissions).
mod_finding: Cesarean section was the most common mode of delivery (84.28%) due to fetal distress and thick meconium stained liquor.
